frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval to block a major international nuclear cooperation agreement within the statutory window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements or major nuclear cooperation pacts submitted to Congress where a statutory disapproval mechanism existed. Excludes non-binding understandings or routine commercial licenses.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 major highly contested agreements identified in the modern era where resolutions of disapproval were introduced but none successfully passed both chambers to block the agreement.
known_gaps: Minor technical amendments and peaceful use updates omitted as they lack high-salience advance signaling states.
skeleton: All formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress with advanced signal states over the modern legislative era
multiplier: 3 observed cases in population x 0 successful blocks = 0 hits
validity_reason: The institutional dynamics of the Atomic Energy Act review process and presidential veto leverage remain stable across administrations.
